Similarly, I need to find the specific action that makes the "rably" "atory". Next time, I will systematically test the remaining actions ("ceous", "thoty", "heted") on the "secti" and "rably" specifically to achieve the "nolog" and "atory" states, respectively, before typing "> done". I will not assume the task is complete until all three specific conditions (secti=nolog, rably=atory, imped=unpish) are explicitly confirmed by the game master.
